svg.text: The farthest box: rear face, outer lane A, bottom level 1 — with the carriage parked at the top. No box has to be moved out of the way.
worst case 6.1 s to the hand-over (9.3 s conservative)
Z 0.8 m/s · X 0.5 m/s · hook 0.4 m/s
every one of the 96 boxes is one move away
Close-up: the J-hook at the box end (side section)

g.text: (a) approach: tip 2 mm below the seat
(b) carriage +5 mm: tip 3 mm in the seat
(c) pull: the tip drags the rim

svg.text: Top view of level 1: the hook pulls the box onto the carriage
0 Carriage waits empty at the top, lane B
1 Z down 1.75 m, X to lane A 2.45 s
2 Settle; ToF + NFC check the box 0.15 s
3 Z +5 mm: tip into the hook seat 0.20 s
5 Z up, X back to lane B 2.45 s
No digging: every box hangs in its
own slot, so the worst case is just
The hook stays engaged while Z
travels, so the box cannot slide.

g.text: 0 Wanted: the bottom box of the outer lane at the back. The carriage waits at the top, empty
1 Z drives down 1.75 m while X moves to lane A; the carriage runners stop 5 mm below the rack runners
2 Settle: a distance sensor checks the box sits right, the NFC reader confirms its tag
3 The whole carriage rises 5 mm: the hook tip slides up behind the downturned rim of the box
4 The hook pulls: the box slides off the rack runners onto the carriage runners (≤ 30 N)
5 Up to the top and back to lane B, under the roof hatch; the load cell weighs the box
7 The gallery gripper comes down through the hatch, grips the box ends and lifts it out
